d: Watch the official 4K upgraded music video for “Snow (Hey Oh)” by Red Hot Chili Peppers. Released as a single from their 2006 double album Stadium Arcadium, the track showcases the band’s signature blend of melodic alternative rock and funk rock. Following landmark albums including Californication and Blood Sugar Sex Magik, “Snow (Hey Oh)” became one of the defining songs of the Stadium Arcadium era.
